description: Set the value parameters that affect the markers.

keywords.name: spacing
keywords.description: Set spacing between the markers. This parameters is used when generating the markers inside a Mine Block that can cave. This is a multiplier relative to the Mine Block size. The default value is 0.25, meaning the spacing between the markers will not be less than one quarter of the Mine Block size.

notes: `spacing` is a fraction of the mine-block size, so the marker population scales steeply with it: on the tutorial model at day 5, spacing 0.5 gave 476 markers and spacing 0.25 gave 4865.
Spacing is a discretisation choice, not just a display density — it changes the extracted-mass accounting (11700 vs 10359 over the same 5 days in that test), because extraction moves whole markers.
